script_text: Scorpio, you're about to hit a wall the cosmos built on purpose. The Moon is squaring Pluto this morning, then Mars enters a tense opposition to your ruling planet Pluto in the 8th House of Transformation. That's raw emotional pressure meeting buried power — nothing subtle here, and you can feel it in your bones all day long. If you're single, a sudden conversation after midnight will shift everything in ways you didn't expect. If taken, your partner hides something real — ask directly before noon, don't wait for hints or wishful thinking. Mercury conjunct Jupiter in your 10th House of Status is pushing a major promotion or visibility opportunity your way — but only if you speak up before 3 PM sharp. Avoid signing any contract before sunset tonight, the ink isn't dry yet and could cost you dearly. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
